_comment: Authoritative role -> dispatch-class policy (roadmap#275). Harness-neutral: names no model, vendor or harness. A dispatch class is a tier from the operator's profile.yaml models: block, optionally at that tier's raised effort ('<tier>+raised'). 'default' is what the PM dispatches; 'opt_in' classes are allowed only with a 'superhuman-tier-opt-in: <reason>' line in the task brief AND a SUPERHUMAN.md decisions-log entry. adaptation/dispatch.md renders this table for humans; tests/test_role_tiers.py keeps the two in sync. Keys under 'roles' are roles/<name>.md stems; keys under 'duties' are non-role dispatches (prompt opens with 'superhuman-dispatch: non-role').
